CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: Required by the identity adapter for cookie-authenticated mutations.

LastEventId.name: Last-Event-ID
LastEventId.description: Decimal durable event sequence last processed by the client; each event resource has an independent sequence.

RunEventView.name: view
RunEventView.description: Client view hides bounded transient retry noise; audit preserves every durable event.

ThreadHistoryView.name: view
ThreadHistoryView.description: Standard view hides deleted content and emits only its tombstone event; audit requires thread:audit:read and preserves durable history.

AutomationView.description: Redacted immutable manual-only Automation definition. Tenant, actor, schedules, digests and invocation routes are private.

AutomationInvocationView.description: Safe public association between one Automation definition and its admitted Run. Private invocation IDs, digests and route bindings are omitted.

RunAutomationNowResponse.description: The Run is projected from the canonical Automation invocation result; private origin bindings and route digests are omitted.

ThreadRolledBackEventView.description: Redacted durable rollback delivery event. Private marker identifiers, raw history ranges, actor identity and tenancy are never exposed.

content.description: Complete public Plan body. The server enforces a 9999-byte UTF-8 hard limit; maxLength is the provider-neutral character upper bound.

timeUsedSeconds.description: Cumulative whole seconds while this Goal is attributed to a started durable Run. Queued time and idle time between Runs are excluded.

eventSequence.description: Durable Thread Goal event sequence at the same Store read point as goal. Use it as Last-Event-ID when attaching the Goal event stream.

name.description: A redacted direct-child name of at most 255 UTF-8 bytes; never a path.

entries.description: Entries in strict raw UTF-8 byte order.

WorkspaceOperationView.description: Redacted Workspace operation projection. No provider, device, binding, lease, path, principal, policy, or digest internals are exposed.

eventSequence.description: Atomic cursor exactly equal to operation.revision.

agentVersionId.description: Optional immutable AgentVersion selection. The server admits it before creating a Run; omission uses the configured default.
Requested immutable AgentVersion; null uses the active default. The resolved route is server-owned.

executionIntent.description: Atomic Turn intent. Goal creates or updates the persistent Thread Goal; Plan clears it and pins this Run to Plan collaboration mode.

agentVersionId.description: Requested immutable AgentVersion for the compactor; null uses the active default.

purpose.description: Immutable Run purpose. Omitted only by legacy servers and interpreted as turn.
